name: Lin Wenqi
headline: MAKING
visual ideas real.
intro: From shader-driven material response to modular environment construction, I build and refine the systems behind visual ideas.
about: I’m a computer science undergraduate exploring technical art and environment art. Whether it’s the spring of a soft surface or the shape of a hillside street, the look I have in mind guides what I build. The breakdown and development notes share the tests and revisions behind the images.

projects.name: Project Kinetica
projects.summary: Kinetica samples weapon motion and evaluates each impact in Unity. The result drives localized vertex deformation and material-specific VFX, giving Slime a springy rebound, Stone a burst of debris and Metal a brief spray of sparks.

preview.alt: Hammer impact deforming the blue Slime target, with droplets above its surface.

projects.name: Project Confluence
projects.summary: An ongoing Unreal Engine 5 study of a dense coastal city adapting to a changing climate. A terraced blockout places housing alongside a rail corridor, while modular facade tests explore how its residential buildings fit together.

preview.alt: Coastal district blockout with white building masses, an early textured balcony facade, hillside walking routes and an elevated rail corridor beside the ocean.
